selection_rule: Leaf interaction classes below HLAmanager whose pinned 1516.2-2025 MIM declaration has sharing=Publish; compared against the 1516.1-2025 Table 7 P designation.
interpretation: case_ids identify public Catch2 evidence mapped to the clause-level requirement; they do not establish that the whole Table 7 set is validated or conformant. Private process cases are deliberately excluded from public coverage.
cpp_tck_mapping_policy: public_cpp_tck_scenario_ids are leaf-level navigation to direct public TCK witnesses. Partial leaf witnesses are not assigned as direct coverage of the all-P-leaves clause requirement until every exact-name P leaf is accounted for; the unresolved RL-393 name conflict remains separate.

classes.cpp_tck_scope_note: The primary and contract C++ TCK cases passed in HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE modes against the installed Umbra package using the adapter-managed process-failure fixture. They verify delivery of HLAreportFederateLost, all four standard parameters, lost-federate identity/name, timestamp decoding, fault description, and reliable transportation. Evidence: out/mgw/federate-lost-installed-package-fixture-20261031.json. This is current Umbra package evidence for one P leaf, not independent-provider or all-P-leaf conformance.
